bootstrap.scope: Pointwise; conditional on each fixed benchmark collection and policy seed. No cross-seed uncertainty or published-system equivalence test.

latency_estimand: Equal-weight mean of episode cycle means; exclude first episode per task/arm. Simulator/reset excluded. Refresh/reuse means are separately cycle-pooled.

manifest.revision_note: Schema-3 numerical gate: unchanged error threshold, direct CPU cache snapshots replace stale/fresh ratio requirement. Original schema-2 failure preserved separately.

source_scope: Recorded identity matched to independently hashed local archive.

stock_repeat.scope: Recorded episode outcomes and lengths; not action-tensor equality.
